title: Check Signal Attributes
text: Error when input signal does or does not match selected attributes exactly, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Specific floating-point} sets Specific; {Error when input} sets the generate error when input Does not match attributes, {Complexity}, {Dimensionality}, {Dimensions}, {Data type}, {General data type}, {Specific fixed-point}, {Specific integer} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Error when input
params.values: Generate error when input Does not match attributes exactly (default) | Matches attributes exactly

params.name: Dimensionality
params.values: Dimensionality check Ignore (default) | Is... | Is not...

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: Specify dimensions 1-D (default) | 2-D | Scalar (1-D or 2-D) | Vector (1-D or 2-D) | Vector (1-D or 2-D) or scalar | Row vector (2-D) | Row vector (2-D) or scalar | Column vector (2-D) | Column vector (2-D) or scalar | Full matrix (2-D) | Square matrix (2-D)

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type check Ignore (default) | Is... | Is not...

params.name: General data type
params.values: General data type check Boolean (default) | Enumerated | Floating-point | Floating-point or boolean | Fixed-point | Integer

params.name: Specific floating-point
params.values: Specific floating-point check Any floating-point (default) | Double precision | Single precision

params.name: Specific fixed-point
params.values: Specific fixed-point check Any fixed-point (default) | Signed fixed-point | Unsigned fixed-point

params.name: Specific integer
params.values: Specific integer check Any integer (default) | Signed integer | Unsigned integer | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time check Ignore (default) | Discrete | Continuous
